subject: Next steps & calendar options — Eval kickoff (PulseMed)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
To: Lindsey Harris <lindsey@pulse-med.com>, Tom Avery <t.avery@pulse-med.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-23T14:15:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps & calendar options — Eval kickoff (PulseMed)

Hi Lindsey / Tom —

Thanks again for the thoughtful discussion today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: run a 3-week evaluation focused on (1) automated clinical note summarization and (2) triage routing prompts.
- Success criteria (draft): 1) 90% reduction in average summarization time vs. manual, 2) >85% accuracy on triage label top-1 vs. benchmark, 3) acceptable latency under 500ms median for interactive workflows.
- Trial plan: Redwood hosts a private eval cluster for PulseMed, we run customer prompt sets + sandboxed test data, and push a small prompt/eval loop for regression checks.

Action items from our call: 
1) Schedule eval kickoff (45–60m): we’ll cover trial scope, data access, success metrics, and logistics. Please pick a slot below.
2) Share initial prompt pack and trial charter (attached).
3) Ben (CC) will join for the technical deep-dive to confirm integration points and security questions.

Proposed kickoff times (PST):
- Tue Aug 25, 10:00–11:00am
- Wed Aug 26, 2:30–3:30pm

If neither works, tell me two windows that do and I’ll lock.

Attachments: PulseMed_trial-charter_v1.pdf (draft trial plan), sample-prompt-pack.csv (small prompt/test set preview).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-3210

--

From: Lindsey Harris <lindsey@pulse-med.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Avery <t.avery@pulse-med.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & calendar options — Eval kickoff (PulseMed)

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with our internal thinking — the two candidate use cases are spot on. We have a couple quick clarifications before we lock a slot: 

- On "sandboxed test data": can you confirm if Redwood will host the data in a private VPC for the eval, or do we need to provide an export?
- For the success criteria, the triage label benchmark is something our clinical ops team manages; we’ll confirm the exact metric to use (expected by EOD Monday).

For calendar availability: Tue Aug 25 at 10am PST works for both Tom and me. Could you also add a 15-minute pre-call with Ben if he wants to review ingestion options?

Thanks — attaching a short org note for visibility.

Best,
Lindsey
Lindsey Harris
Head of Clinical Ops, PulseMed
lindsey@pulse-med.com

Attachment: PulseMed_org-chart.pdf (org chart, 1 page)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
To: Lindsey Harris <lindsey@pulse-med.com>, Tom Avery <t.avery@pulse-med.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & calendar options — Eval kickoff (PulseMed)

Great — locking Tue Aug 25, 10:00–11:00am PST for the eval kickoff. Calendar invite sent separately.

Quick answers:
- Data hosting: Redwood can host a sandbox in a VPC-isolated environment for the eval (preferred) — we’ll provide an S3 bucket with restricted credentials and an ingestion guide. If PulseMed prefers to push data, we can accept a secure export (SFTP or secure upload).
- Pre-call with Ben: happy to set a 15-min touchpoint at 9:30am PST on Aug 25; Ben, does that work for you?

Attached the draft trial charter and a very small prompt pack (sample-prompt-pack.csv). Please review the success metrics and the data handling section ahead of the kickoff so we can finalize scope.

Ben — FYI on the pre-call: Lindsey flagged that their ingestion will likely come from an internal data export pipeline and they want to understand the minimum schema/PII redaction expectations. I put the preliminary security/compliance notes in the charter (section 3).

Thanks all — talk Tue.

Best,
Grace

Attachments: PulseMed_trial-charter_v1.pdf, sample-prompt-pack.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
Cc: Lindsey Harris <lindsey@pulse-med.com>, Tom Avery <t.avery@pulse-med.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & calendar options — Eval kickoff (PulseMed)

9:30am PST pre-call works for me — I’ll join and bring a short checklist:
- Minimal ingestion schema + example payload
- PII redaction recommendations + sample scripts
- Endpoint auth and temporary credentials flow (short-lived keys)
- Required security artifacts (SOC2 summary, data retention policy) — I’ll attach the SOC2 snapshot to the calendar invite.

Lindsey, if you can share the export schema ahead of the pre-call (or a sample row), that’ll speed things up. Looking forward to Tuesday.

Cheers,
Ben
